# Version 4.150.6
> **Ganesh GPU failure handling** · Released October 28, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.6) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.6)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.6/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.6/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.6 improves how Ganesh handles failed GPU work, including buffer uploads under memory pressure. This Skia m150 servicing release leaves the managed API surface unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **More accurate GPU failure handling** — Ganesh distinguishes render-task execution from success so flush status reflects failed tasks or intermediate GPU submissions. Additional buffer-upload checks make affected work fail instead of drawing stale buffer contents under memory pressure. This does not guarantee detection of every upload failure. ([#5258](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5258), [#5323](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5323))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.6

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
